description: Warren Grimes's airborne test bed for aircraft lighting carrying over 75 lights; FAA registry current with N8640E registered to the Grimes Flying Lab Foundation of Urbana Ohio as a Beech C-45H serial AF-510 on an experimental research and development certificate; the museum describes it as a 1952 USAF C-45H but the USAF serial has not been established so the civil registration is the identifier and AF-510 is the Beech remanufacture number not a USAF serial
aliases: Beech 18; Model 18; AF-510; C45; C45H; AF510
